## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is addressed (if any).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New diagnostic rule
- [ ] Improvement to existing diagnostic check
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance or reliability enhancement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and formatting guidelines of this project (`npm run format:check`).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have run the linter and verified no errors (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] I have run type checks without errors (`npm run typecheck`).
- [ ] I have added automated tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`npm test`).
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally.
- [ ] No real credentials, private information, or test tokens with real accounts are included in this PR.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README where appropriate.
